reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing single predicate shouldFillCategory and the shared getAverageFillCategories loader instead of adding new filtering.

duplication.why: The hidden exception is expressed once inside shouldFillCategory; the actions only forward the flag.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the documented single definition of fillable categories in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its loader, the month-wide action signatures and one focused test change.

maintainability.why: One optional parameter on the shared predicate with a defaulted value and updated comment; straightforward to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) still decides via shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; actions only pass includeHiddenCategories through.
